budget_protocol: Each budget is a hard GPU-second allowance per arm and seed block, including all concurrent workers. Complete only whole fixed-work invocations. Check correctness on each completed invocation; summarize repeated same-seed outputs within a block as one seed metric. For throughput compare completed invocation count / charged GPU seconds; paired speedup = method throughput / baseline throughput. If either completes zero invocations or a full job exceeds allowance, record timeout and fail that test, no partial-job credit. No numeric outcome curve forecast. Compute budgets do not authorize extra paths or scale changes.

confidence_rule.exact_decision: Use exact Binomial(n,0.5) order-statistic intervals, no Gaussian approximations. Performance: for sorted paired baseline/method GPU-second ratios, choose largest k with P[Binomial(n,0.5)<=k-1] <= 0.05; one-sided lower bound is ratio_(k). Require lower bound > minimum_worthwhile_gain. Equivalence: m=1 metric, Bonferroni per-tail alpha/(2*m)=0.025; choose largest k with Binomial CDF(k-1)<=0.025; CI=[difference_(k),difference_(n-k+1)]. Require finite CI strictly inside both margins. n=64 gives k=24. Ties handled conservatively. Insufficient finite observations produce no equivalence or performance success.
confidence_rule.multiplicity: Bonferroni across equivalence metrics within each predeclared method/budget test. Report all nine method/budget decisions separately; no simultaneous family claim across these nine tests. Method success requires all its budgets to pass equivalence and performance. Failure to reject a difference is never equivalence.

correctness_requirements: Every completed invocation must have Average reserve strictly >1.0, Test passed, exit status 0 and exact declared configuration. At printed reserve=1.000000 use unrounded statistic or verdict. These are upstream eligibility predicates, not zero-tolerance stochastic equivalence metrics. Record L1 without inventing an acceptance threshold.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed option and path counts define fixed scientific work; no calibrated target-versus-budget outcome curve. Statistical pricing-error equivalence and upstream correctness are mandatory at every budget.

equivalence_metrics.baseline_variability_calibration: Before any method output is inspected, run baseline only on calibration seeds 200 through 231. For each option, s_i = sqrt(mean over those seeds of (reported discounted confidence halfwidth_i/1.96)^2). Freeze these scales and calibration artifacts for all methods and budgets. No observed values currently available. Require finite positive scales; failed or zero scales invalidate evaluation and require a new sealed run, never a chosen floor or changed margin.
equivalence_metrics.definition: For each seed and arm, mean over the fixed option set of abs(MC price - pinned analytic Black-Scholes price)/s_i. Paired difference is method metric minus baseline metric. s_i is the positive per-option baseline Monte Carlo standard error for PATH_N=262144, frozen from baseline-only calibration described below.
equivalence_metrics.interpretation: Equivalence concerns mean absolute standardized pricing error; it does not assert per-option equality or bitwise identity. Accept only if the entire two-sided paired-median CI lies strictly within (-1.96,1.96).
equivalence_metrics.name: mean_absolute_standardized_pricing_error
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/brief.md and intake/benchmark.json scoring: upstream discounted confidence halfwidth = 1.96 Monte Carlo standard errors, compared against analytic Black-Scholes. Scientific margin sealed here is one such halfwidth in baseline-SE units; upstream publishes no L1 equivalence threshold. This normalized margin is a prospective scientific assumption, not measured variability or an upstream equivalence claim.

evaluation_inputs.anchors: Separately check published 8192-option, 262144-path, one-GPU anchors; never substitute anchor workload for representative timings.

generated_specification.generator: Pinned upstream srand(123)/libc rand option generation; freeze generated option arrays and record hashes before methods. Record libc, GPU model, grid geometry, CUDA/cuRAND and driver. Values/hashes unavailable at sealing.

evidence_status: Profile measured total wall 1.3087970930000097 s; kernels 36.8069%, CUDA API host 38.3186%, other host 24.8386%, combined transfers 0.0359484%. Concurrent factors are throughput evidence on one GPU only. No method measurements, scientific baseline SE arrays, powered-effect observations, input hashes or outcome curves supplied. Margins use frozen baseline-SE units and the published 1.96-SE halfwidth convention; interval overheads and power alternatives are explicit prospective assumptions.
execution_limits: Honor intake stage budgets: method_run 1200 s, tests 900 s, evaluate 2400 s; no scale search, path doubling or optional continuation. Timeout or missing seed/metric adapter yields failed or unavailable evaluation, never unsupported success.

hardware_cost_basis.accounting: One visible GPU, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; charge allocated GPU count times synchronized process wall seconds, including host idle time. Concurrent workers share one allocation; charge elapsed allocation wall once, not worker-time sums. Same GPU, clocks, MPS setting, toolkit, libc and geometry in both arms. Hardware identity is unavailable now; record before execution and freeze across arms.

infeasible_methods.reason: One visible GPU; equal-GPU-second Amdahl/k ceiling is 1, below 1.05.
Transfer fraction 0.00035948353072938596 with k=2 yields ceiling 1.0001797740782747, below 1.05; extra synchronization can dominate.

paired_seed_tests.aggregation: One correctness metric pair per held-out seed per budget and method. Timing repetitions of a seed never increase equivalence sample size.
paired_seed_tests.pairing: Host option seed remains 123. Each listed seed selects an independent logical Monte Carlo replicate, identical across arms. Preserve per-option logical path identities across partitioning and batching; ensembles partition exactly 262144 total paths per option and merge sufficient statistics with correct weights.
paired_seed_tests.seed_adapter_requirement: Pinned source has no seed CLI and uses block/device-derived seeds. Future evaluation adapter must expose replicate seed and stable logical stream mapping in both arms; no seed implementation is claimed here. If unavailable, evaluation is invalid rather than treating repeated fixed-seed runs as independent samples.

power.assumptions: Independent seed-level differences, no systematic drift, and at least 0.90 probability that a difference lies strictly within the sealed margin, for each method and budget. Hence each outside tail has probability at most 0.10. This is an unverified planning assumption; baseline/method variance and achieved power are unavailable.
power.calculation: For n=64 and order-statistic index k=24, probability of CI escaping either margin is at most 2*P[Binomial(64,0.10)>=k]. Baseline-only calibration is excluded from confirmatory observations. No post-hoc seed increase or stopping.

splits.policy: Calibration baseline only; held-out outputs cannot tune implementation, margins, inputs, scheduling, seeds or scale. Same option identities in all replicates; randomness split is by Monte Carlo replicate. Any scope/tolerance change requires new sealed run.
splits.training: None; no fitted model or external dataset.

timing_pair_protocol: Nine timing pairs per method and budget on the single declared input. Use held-out seeds 1000 through 1008 for these pairs; remaining held-out seeds provide equivalence observations. Seeded PRNG randomizes method/budget block order and independently AB versus BA in every timing pair. Finish both arms of a pair before next pair; no cross-arm overlap. Hold input, replicate seed and budget fixed within pair. Record failures and timeouts; never silently discard, replace, or cherry-pick pairs.

timing_scope.description: Measure complete process wall from launch through synchronized completion and result merge; include process and kernel launch, initialization, allocation, option preprocessing, H2D/D2H transfers, RNG, GPU pricing, completion waits, CPU finalization, Black-Scholes checks and merge. Exclude compilation and separate baseline calibration. For concurrent invocations use common allocation start to last completion. Record reported Total time (ms.) secondarily. Profile ceiling remains a hard ceiling; differences between profiled and complete-process scope are unmeasured uncertainty.

warmup_protocol: Exactly two complete fixed-scale invocations per arm before recorded timing, synchronized; exclude their time from measurements, account separately in execution stage budget. Warmups use seeds 300 and 301, excluded from calibration and inference.
